name: Samsung C&T Construction Anchor Robot
summary: Mobile robot that drills holes in concrete ceilings and sets anchors (drilling, punching and nailing) for hanging sprinkler pipes and lights, with autonomous and manual driving and a dust collector. Developed by the Korean contractor Samsung C&T for its own sites; the fourth generation has been used on Korean projects since 2023.

germany.statusNote: Not sold: Samsung C&T develops the anchor robot for its own construction sites in Korea; no sale, rental or licence offer was found, in Germany or elsewhere.

specs.label: Cycle time per anchor
specs.quote: 18% reduction in construction cycle time (compared to 3rd generation, from 140 seconds to 115 seconds)

specs.label: Crew
specs.conditions: manual anchoring: two people per team
specs.quote: 50% reduction in workforce required on site (from two people on one team to one person working)

specs.label: Automated steps
specs.value: drilling, punching and nailing of anchors
specs.quote: Automation of all anchor installation tasks, including drilling, punching, and nailing

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: vision, lidar and laser sensors; automatic dust collection
specs.quote: Application of vision, lidar, and laser sensors and automatic dust collection device

specs.label: Safety certification
specs.quote: Safety certification through KCs autonomous safety confirmation report

notes: Driving part combines autonomous and manual driving (maker); wheels and a single drilling unit assumed, the pages do not describe the chassis.
Built for anchors in concrete ceilings of underground car parks, for hanging sprinkler pipes and lights.
First generation 2019, third generation 2021, fourth generation in use from March 2023.

evidence.task: Fourth-generation robot drilled and set ceiling anchors on housing projects
evidence.where: Busan Oncheon 4 (Mar 2023), Hyundai Engineering's Jangan site (Sep 2023), Imun 1 (Oct 2023), South Korea
evidence.note: Jamsil Jinju was listed as planned for October 2024. Earlier generations: Pyeongtaek P3 and Asan 7-2L (Aug 2021), Sinbanpo 3 (2021), Busan Geoje 2 (May 2022).

evidence.task: Installs anchors in concrete ceilings to hang sprinkler pipes and lights in underground parking lots; used in the field with a KCs safety certification
